title: avva — your expertise, as an MCP any AI can consult
excerpt: Built from your past decisions. Ready for someone else’s AI to consult.
content_html:
Built from your past decisions.
Ready for someone else’s AI to consult.

Build from work you already have

Your AI prepares the model. You decide what can be shared.

  1. Connect avva Studio to your AI,

    One link, added once, in the AI that can already see your work.

  2. point it at your past work,

    It finds the decisions you made and the reasons you gave, and writes each one up. Nothing reaches avva yet.

  3. then read the list and approve it.

    You cross out what must not leave, hear the finished model read back, and publish. Years of history can take your AI an hour or more.

Your decisions, ready for someone else’s AI

Publish how you decide, so others can consult your judgment in their own AI. Your Decision Model carries your reasons into new situations. You choose what to share and when to update it.

  • A lawyer

    Which lease clause to challenge before someone signs, and which to concede.

  • An architect

    What to keep in a renovation when the budget shrinks, and what can wait.

  • A recruiter

    When a gap in a résumé needs a question, rather than a rejection.

Why not just write a prompt?

  1. Custom instructions that start “Act as a senior…”
  2. A paragraph of context, pasted into every new chat.
  3. One more correction, when it confidently suggests something you would never do.

A job title tells your AI who to imitate. Your decisions show it what you actually weigh, where you stop, and why.

A Decision Model is a record of what one professional actually decided, and why. It shows how they weigh trade-offs, where they stop, and what won when goals collided. Your AI applies it to new situations and reads the expert’s new version the next time it asks.

Your colleagues’ decisions, shared privately

Put their models in a workspace and ask your own AI to consult them before a review.

  • Only invited colleagues can open it.
  • Off the marketplace: to anyone outside, it looks as if it does not exist.
  • Remove someone and their access stops on their next request.

In the marketplace

One professional per model, with the decisions they made and their reasons.

See the marketplace

Publish how you decide

Free during beta.
